activeFormula.label: Tuned · September 14
activeFormula.objective: Net units at original saved prices, one unit per eligible game; MAE tiebreak
activeFormula.scopeNote: All 58 originally priced college games in the September 9 archive: 1 Thursday, 5 Friday and 52 Saturday. Another 26 modeled games had no saved market. The optimized record is retrospective and remains separate from the recovered Saturday scorecard.
activeFormula.validationNote: Across 728 earlier games, error changed from 15.43 to 14.86 points; early-season 2026 results were weaker. These are inspected retrospective checks, not fresh validation.

selection.label: Same-week optimized; applied forward by explicit user request.

searchStages.refinementBasis: Parent-approved local refinement around preliminary Saturday-only coarse winner; all final candidates scored on full58.

protocol.objective: Maximize net units at one unit risked per selection on all58 originally priced games from September10-12. No thresholds, changed stakes, or outcome-dependent omission.
protocol.tieBreak: Rounded-to-1e-10 net units descending, decided comparisons descending, MAE on same58 ascending, stable candidate ID.
protocol.otherObjectives: Win rate on same58, MAE on same58, and separately MAE on all84 original model forecasts.
protocol.interpretation: Chosen after seeing September10-12 results. Same-week optimized hindsight performance, not out-of-sample proof. User requested immediate use for the next week.

notes: Original Sep9 history is the ONLY candidate team-coefficient fit input for September10-12 selection.

Current collection supplies finals for the six original Thursday/Friday forecasts included in the full58 optimization, plus next-week training and schedules. It never enters the pre-Sep9 candidate fits.
FCS-only group81 games are excluded to preserve incumbent training population.
